capabilities: Show a floating Ask AI button next to selected text in Live Preview
Open Copilot Quick Ask from the selection without the context menu
Optionally prefill the Quick Ask input with the selected text
Offer a Switch to Live Preview shortcut when text is selected in Reading view
extras: Free, makes no network requests, reads no API keys, and collects no telemetry; AI requests and costs come from Copilot and the chosen model provider. Compatibility is pinned to Copilot 4.0.15 and may break on Copilot updates. Desktop only; mobile, Source mode, and PDF selections are unsupported. Interface is Simplified Chinese or English.
intentEvidence: The integration targets Copilot 4.0.15 and depends on its copilot:trigger-quick-ask command, popup controller, and input structure.
problem: Asking AI about selected text requires using the context menu or commands; there is no one-click button at the selection to open Copilot Quick Ask.

relations.evidence: Copilot, by Logan Yang, installed and enabled.

summary: Floating button over selected text that opens Copilot's Quick Ask popup, with an optional setting to prefill the question box with the selection.
